name: lane-lock
summary: One owner per lane (a repo or scope) at a time, plus a circuit breaker that stops new work on a lane whose last gate checks both failed.

env.HUBKIT_HOME: install root, default ~/.claude/hubkit (claims and breakers go under $HUBKIT_HOME/state/lanes)
env.LANE_LOCK_ROOT: optional: folder for lane records, default $HUBKIT_HOME/state/lanes
env.LANE_BREAKER_THRESHOLD: consecutive FAILs that trip the breaker, default 2
env.LANE_LOCK_REPORTS: optional: folder holding cited judge rulings (judge/<name>.md, <ticket>/judge-r<N>.md), default $HUBKIT_HOME/reports
env.LANE_LOCK_WAIT_S: seconds to wait for the short per-lane lock, default 5

needs: macOS or Linux (uses ps and process ids)
